description: This Java source file defines the 'MasterController' class, which is a Spring MVC controller managing web requests related to users, tickets, and authentication views. It handles routing for the home page, user list, ticket list based on user ID or role, logout, and access denied pages.

classes.name: MasterController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller managing web requests for the application, including user, ticket, and authentication-related views.

methods.name: showHome
methods.description: Handles requests for the home page, returning the index view with a flag to display the home content.

methods.name: showUser
methods.description: Handles requests for displaying the list of users, returning a view with user list data.

methods.name: showVehicle
methods.description: Handles requests for displaying tickets, filtering based on user ID if provided, otherwise based on user role.

methods.name: showLogout
methods.description: Handles requests for logging out, returning index view with home flag.

methods.name: getTicketListBasedOnRole
methods.description: Private method that retrieves tickets based on the current user's role; if the user has ROLE_USER, fetches tickets for that user, otherwise fetches all tickets.
